title: Rabbi Zeira, Head of the Synagogue of Tzippori
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Rosh, Hilkhot Tumah, and in Yuchasin. Hyman considers the Rosh’s wording slightly erroneous, for the source is Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1, folio 20b, where, when Rabbi Yehudah Nesia died, Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba pushed Rabbi Ze’ira into the synagogue of Gufna in Tzippori and made him impure. Hyman identifies him as the first Rabbi Zeira, the colleague of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba.

notes.text: The supplied Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:1 is retained; the saved bounded 2:1 check did not locate this story. Saved Guggenheimer 3:1 contains the Gufna synagogue episode during a Nasi’s death, following the death of Rabbi Yehudah Nesia’s grandson, also named Rabbi Yehudah Nesia. Hyman’s first-Rabbi-Zeira identification and criticism of the Rosh remain attributed, without resolving all historical identities.
